results.lastReply:
For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/i7 chip. Those matter more than a fancy graphics card.

RAM: 16 GB is the minimum. Pick one you can upgrade to 32 GB later.
Screen: 14 to 15.6 inch, full HD, and matte if you can get it. You'll stare at code all day.
Keyboard and battery: try the keyboard in a shop if possible, and look for 8+ hours of real use.
Graphics card: only needed for AI training, games or video work. Skip it for web, apps or general coding.

A Windows laptop with WSL (Linux inside Windows) works well for most coding. If you build iPhone apps, you'll need a Mac instead.

What do you mostly build: web and apps, or AI and data work? Once I know, I can look up current options and prices for you.
